hub.title: Shingle Roof Cost Guide & Price Estimator (2026)
hub.nationalAverageRange: $8,200 – $14,500 for a standard 2,000 sq ft roof

perSquareGuide.title: Shingle Roof Cost Per Square (100 Sq Ft) Explained
perSquareGuide.definition: In the roofing industry, one 'square' equals 100 square feet of roof surface area. A typical 2,000 square foot home with a 1.25 pitch multiplier requires approximately 25 to 28 roofing squares including waste allowance.

pitchMultipliers.laborImpact: Standard pitch; walkable without roof jacks
+30% to +50% steep charge (harnesses, staging, slow walk)

materials.title: Asphalt Shingle Roof Cost Guide (2026)

good.name: Standard 3-Tab
good.desc: Budget-friendly single-layer 25-yr shingles for rental properties and dry climates.

better.name: Architectural (Dimensional)
better.desc: Dual-layered laminated 30-yr shingles; North America's top residential choice.

best.name: Designer / Class 4 Impact
best.desc: Thick premium designer cuts with SBS polymer modification for maximum hail defense.

costDrivers: Roof surface area and slope pitch
Number of existing shingle layers to tear off ($1.00 - $1.75/sq ft per layer)
Plywood decking repair or replacement ($65 - $110 per 4x8 sheet)
Flashing upgrades around chimneys, skylights, and valleys

materials.title: Wood & Cedar Shingle Roof Cost Guide (2026)

good.name: #2 Grade Cedar Shingles
good.desc: Mixed grain cedar for secondary structures or budget siding.

better.name: #1 Blue Label Red Cedar
better.desc: 100% edge grain, knot-free Western Red Cedar shingles for prime homes.

best.name: Class A Fire-Treated Hand-Split Shakes
best.desc: Pressure-impregnated fire-retardant premium shakes with deep shadow lines.

costDrivers: Grade of cedar (Grade 1 Blue Label vs Grade 2)
Hand-split shakes vs sawn uniform shingles
Factory fire-retardant or fungicide pressure treatment
Installation of breathable batten matrix underlayment

materials.title: Metal Shingle Roof Cost Guide (2026)

better.name: Stone-Coated Galvalume Steel
better.desc: Ceramic granule embedded steel resisting 140 mph winds and Class 4 hail.

best.name: Interlocking Stamped Aluminum / Copper-Clad
best.desc: Zero-rust aluminum alloy engineered for lifetime coastal saltwater resilience.

costDrivers: Metal gauge and alloy (Galvalume steel vs aluminum)
Stone-coated granule finish vs PVDF Kynar 500 paint
Complex flashing accessories at hips, valleys, and rakes
Overlay vs complete tear-off of underlying shingles

materials.title: Rubber Shingle Roof Cost Guide (2026)

good.name: Standard Recycled Rubber Slate Profile
good.desc: Clean slate texture molded from upcycled tire polymers.

better.name: Architectural Rubber Shake Profile
better.desc: Hand-split wood grain aesthetic with Class 4 hail rating.

best.name: Heavy-Duty Heritage Rubber Tile
best.desc: Extra-thick elastomeric formulation rated for 2-inch hail deflection and 50-year warranty.

costDrivers: Tile thickness and formulation (recycled crumb vs virgin elastomeric blends)
Certified installer network availability in the region
Ice and water barrier underlayment requirements
Insurance premium discounts offsetting lifetime cost

materials.title: Composite Shingle Roof Cost Guide (2026)

good.name: Single-Width Composite Slate
good.desc: Uniform width synthetic tiles with authentic stone beveling.

better.name: Multi-Width Composite Slate / Shake
better.desc: Varied widths and blended color shades for high natural realism.

best.name: Select Hand-Split Composite Shake
best.desc: Heavy-butt synthetic shakes with Class A fire rating and lifetime warranty.

costDrivers: Single-width vs multi-width randomized bundles
Class A vs Class C fire-retardant underlayment system
Hip and ridge cap tile packages
Savings from avoiding structural rafter reinforcement (unlike real slate)

materials.title: Slate Shingle Roof Cost Guide (2026)

good.name: Standard S2 Commercial Slate
good.desc: Imported or secondary quarry slate with 40-75 year expected life.

better.name: Vermont S1 Grade Clear Slate
better.desc: Premium domestic quarry stone certified to exceed 100 years of life.

best.name: Graduated Structural Heavy Slate
best.desc: Random-width, heavy-thickness historic custom installations with copper pans.

costDrivers: Quarry origin and ASTM C406 grade (S1 vs S2)
Structural engineering inspection and rafter reinforcement
Solid copper nails and custom 16-20 oz soldered copper flashing
Master slater specialized artisan labor rates

materials.title: Solar Shingle Roof Cost Guide (2026)

good.name: Partial Array Hybrid (Solar + Asphalt)
good.desc: Active BIPV tiles on sunny roof facets matched with asphalt elsewhere.

better.name: Full Array BIPV System
better.desc: Complete integrated glass solar roof tiles across all primary faces.

best.name: Solar Shingles + Home Battery Storage
best.desc: Full solar shingle roof paired with whole-home backup battery system.

costDrivers: System electrical wattage capacity (kW DC array size)
Inverter, microinverter, and rapid shutdown electrical hardware
Utility electrical service panel upgrade (100A to 200A/400A)
30% Federal Clean Energy Tax Credit (IRC Section 25D) reduction
